mapper.select: SELECT member_id, cookie, has_ex_access FROM eh_credentials WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eh_credentials (user_id, member_id, cookie, has_ex_access, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memberId}, #{cookie}, #{hasExAccess}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET member_id = excluded.member_id, cookie = excluded.cookie, has_ex_access = excluded.has_ex_access, updated_at = now()
